projectTitle: Alzheimer disease lateral temporal lobe versus old control brain
contrastDefinition: Alzheimer disease lateral temporal lobe bulk RNA-seq versus age-matched old control tissue
sampleGroupSource: Parsed from GEO sample titles (`*-Old` controls, `*-AD` Alzheimer disease); `Young` samples are excluded from the manuscript contrast.
batchHandlingRule: DESeq2 design = ~ group; no explicit batch or age covariate is available for the AD samples in the series matrix.
notes: Neural replication cohort. Uses the AD versus Old-control contrast only; Young controls remain outside the active manuscript comparison.
